                                     固 本 培 元 即 鞏 固 根 本， 培 養 元 神 的 意 思。

                             固本 培元
                                                                                                                                                         問   切


                                                                                 Gù
                                                                                         元
                                                                                       běn
                                                                                         培                       péi     yuán
                                                                                         本
                                                                                 is an ancient philosophical concept in China.
                                                                                 “Yuan” and “Ben” refer to the root, the primordial spirit,
                                                                                 the fundamental aspect.
                                                                                 “Gu Ben Pei Yuan” means strengthen the foundation and
                                                                                 cultivate the core essence.




Strengthen the foundation
                                                                                《易經》曰：「天行健，君子以自強不息」。


Cultivate the core essence
                                                                                 中醫認為天人相應，人體也應像天體運行那樣，
                                                                                 氣血晝夜流行不息，則生命健而有力，不生疾患。
                                                                                 中年人由於新陳代謝功能逐漸減弱，
                                                                                 排泄功能日益降低，廢物停留體內，勢必造成氣血流行阻滯，影響健康。
                                                                                「固本培元」促使機體氣血流暢，消除代謝產物，使臟腑、
                                                                                 氣血恢復和維護正常的生理功能，保持動態平穩，是十分有效的抗衰老方法。


                                                                                 The I Ching (《易經》) states that “Just as the universe keeps operating ceaselessly and
                                                                                 vitally, a man should continuously strive for self-cultivation.”
                                                                                 Chinese medicine holds the belief that there is a correspondence between heaven and
                                                                                 humans. Just as celestial bodies move in their orbits with unceasing vigor, so too
                                                                                 should the circulation of Qi (氣) and blood within the human body be continuous, day
                                                                                 and night. This uninterrupted flow ensures robust health and vitality, preventing the
                                                                                 occurrence of diseases.
                                                                                 As people reach middle age, their metabolic functions gradually weaken, and their
                                                                                 excretory functions decline. This can lead to the accumulation of waste products within
                                                                                 the body, causing blockages in the flow of Qi and blood, which inevitably affects health.
                                                                                 “Gu Ben Pei Yuan” promotes the smooth flow of Qi and blood within the body,
                                                                                 eliminating metabolic waste. This process helps the organs and Qi and blood to restore
                                                                                 and maintain normal physiological functions, keeping a dynamic balance. It is an
                                                                                 extremely effective anti-aging method.

                                                                 Business combinations are accounted for using the acquisition method. The consideration transferred is           業務合併採用收購法入賬。所轉讓代價按收購日期的公允價值計量，即本

                                                                 assets transferred by the Group, liabilities assumed by the Group to the former owners of the acquiree           被收購方控制權所發行股權於收購日期之公允價值總和。就各項業務合併
                                                                 and the equity interests issued by the Group in exchange for control of the acquiree. For each                   而言，本集團選擇按公允價值或被收購方可識別資產淨值的應佔比例，計
                                                                 business combination, the Group elects whether to measure the non-controlling interests in the                   量於被收購方的非控股權益。非控股權益的所有其他組成部分乃按公允價
                                                                 acquiree at fair value or at the proportionate share of the acquiree’s identifiable net assets. All other        值計量。收購相關成本於產生時支銷。
                                                                 components of non-controlling interests are measured at fair value. Acquisition-related costs are




                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       北京同仁堂國藥有限公司
                                                                 expensed as incurred.

                                                                 The Group determines that it has acquired a business when the acquired set of activities and assets              倘本集團所收購的一組業務及資產包括一項投入及一項實質過程，而兩者
                                                                 includes an input and a substantive process that together significantly contribute to the ability to             對產出具有重大貢獻，則確定其已收購一項業務。
                                                                 create outputs.

                                                                 When the Group acquires a business, it assesses the financial assets and liabilities assumed for                 本集團收購業務時根據按合約條款、收購日期的經濟狀況及相關條件作出
                                                                 appropriate classification and designation in accordance with the contractual terms, economic                    適當分類及指定，以評估所收購及承擔的金融資產及負債，其中包括拆分
                                                                 circumstances and pertinent conditions as at the acquisition date. This includes the separation of               被收購方主合約中的嵌入式衍生工具。
                                                                 embedded derivatives in host contracts of the acquiree.

                                                                 Any contingent consideration to be transferred by the acquirer is recognised at fair value at the                收購方所轉讓的任何或然代價於收購日期按公允價值確認。歸類為資產或
                                                                 acquisition date. Contingent consideration classified as an asset or liability is measured at fair value         負債的或然代價按公允價值計量，而公允價值的變動於損益確認。歸類為
                                                                 with changes in fair value recognised in the statement of profit or loss. Contingent consideration that is       權益之或然代價毋須重新計量，其後結算在權益表中入賬。
                                                                 classified as equity is not remeasured and subsequent settlement is accounted for within equity.

                                                           33.3 Fair value measurement                                                                                         33.3 公允價值計量
                                                              The Group measures its equity investment at fair value at the end of each reporting period. Fair value             本集團於各報告期末按公允價值計量其股權投資。公允價值指於計量日期
                                                              is the price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly                 市場參與者之間的有序交易中，就出售資產將收取之價格或轉讓負債將支




Beijing Tong Ren Tang Chinese Medicine Company Limited
                                                              transaction between market participants at the measurement date. The fair value measurement is based               付之價格。計量公允價值時假設出售資產或轉讓負債之交易於資產或負債
                                                              on the presumption that the transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either in the      的主要市場或（在未有主要市場的情況下）最有利市場進行。主要或最有利
                                                              principal market for the asset or liability, or in the absence of a principal market, in the most                  市場須為本集團能參與的市場。假設市場參與者基於最佳經濟利益行事，
                                                              advantageous market for the asset or liability. The principal or the most advantageous market must be              資產或負債的公允價值使用市場參與者為資產或負債定價時所用假設計量。
                                                              accessible by the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the assumptions
                                                              that market participants would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market
                                                              participants act in their economic best interest.

                                                              The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in the circumstances and for which sufficient             本集團針對不同情況使用不同估值方法，確保有足夠數據計量公允價值，
                                                              data are available to measure fair value, maximising the use of relevant observable inputs and                     並盡可能利用相關可觀察輸入數據，而減少使用不可觀察輸入數據。
                                                              minimising the use of unobservable inputs.

                                                              All assets and liabilities for which fair value is measured or disclosed in the consolidated financial             於合併財務報表計量或披露公允價值之所有資產及負債，均基於對計量公
                                                              statements are categorised within the fair value hierarchy, described as follows, based on the lowest              允價值整體而言屬重大之最低層輸入數據按下述公允價值層級分類：
                                                              level input that is significant to the fair value measurement as a whole:

                                                                Level 1      —       based on quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets for identical assets or                第一級   —    按相同資產或負債於活躍市場之報價（未經調整）
                                                                                     liabilities
                                                                Level 2      —       based on valuation techniques for which the lowest level input that is                       第二級   —    按公允價值計量而言屬重大的可觀察（直接或間接）
                                                                                     significant to the fair value measurement is observable, either directly or                             最低層輸入數據的估值方法
                                                                                     indirectly
222                                                             Level 3      —       based on valuation techniques for which the lowest level input that is                       第三級   —    按公允價值計量而言屬重大的不可觀察最低層輸入
                                                                                     significant to the fair value measurement is unobservable                                               數據的估值方法




                                                                                                                                                                                                                       二零二四年年報
                                                              For assets and liabilities that are recognised in the consolidated financial statements on a recurring             就經常於合併財務報表確認之資產及負債而言，本集團透過於各報告期末
                                                                                                                                                                                 重新評估分類（根據對計量公允價值整體而言屬重大的最低層輸入數據），




Annual Report 2024
                                                              basis, the Group determines whether transfers have occurred between levels in the hierarchy by
                                                              reassessing categorisation (based on the lowest level input that is significant to the fair value                  釐定公允價值層級之間是否出現轉移。
                                                              measurement as a whole) at the end of each reporting period.


                                                           33.4 Impairment of non-financial assets                                                                             33.4 非金融資產減值
                                                              Where an indication of impairment exists, or when annual impairment testing for an asset is required               倘出現減值跡象或有需要就非金融資產（存貨、遞延稅項資產及金融資產除
                                                              (other than inventories, deferred tax assets, and financial assets), the asset’s recoverable amount is             外）進行年度減值測試，則會估計資產之可收回金額。資產之可收回金額為

                                                              risk of a default occurring on the financial instrument as at the reporting date with the risk of a default      工具於初始確認日期發生違約風險進行比較，並考慮毋須過度耗費成本或
                                                              occurring on the financial instrument as at the date of initial recognition and considers reasonable and         努力而取得之合理可靠之資料，包括過往及前瞻性資料。本集團認為，當
                                                              supportable information that is available without undue cost or effort, including historical and forward-        合約付款逾期超過30天時，信用風險顯著增加。
